step.bind: Bambu Connect gudahood, ku dar P2S-kaaga. Mar keliya samee.
step.send: Riix Dir printer 3D. Faylku wuxuu ku furmayaa Bambu Connect: halkaas ka hubi oo bilow daabacaadda.

confirm: OrcaSlicer wuxuu diyaariyay tan isagoo adeegsanaya habaynta P2S: {grams} g, {layers} lakab.
confirm.next: Ku furo Bambu Connect? Waxba ma daabacmayo ilaa halkaas laga bilaabin.
done: Waa loo diray Bambu Connect. Halkaas ka hubi oo bilow daabacaadda.
fail.orca: OrcaSlicer lama helin kombiyuutarkan. Ku rakib, kadibna isku day mar kale.
fail.bed: Tan ma ku habboona saxanka P2S.
fail.connect: Bambu Connect ma furmin. Ku rakib, kadibna isku day mar kale.
